status: exploratory design; implementation and execution pending
question: How sensitive is the paired regional readout to pair ordering and shuffled-label assignments?
pair_schedule: For each replicate, use a seeded permutation of all three training pairs in each of eight epochs. Use the same 24 pair indices for regional, shuffled and generic conditions, and record them before training.
shuffled_control: Derive a deterministic permutation from replicate seed, sequence and memory-frame index; preserve region counts and use the same definition in training and inference. Regional and generic modes do not shuffle.
evaluation: Use the same validation sequences, prompts, checkpoint and metrics as the base pilot. Compare per-sequence present Dice, false alarms and returns against the verified native reference, and report every replicate rather than selecting the best.
verification: Before evaluation verify seed reproducibility, changes between seeds, count-preserving permutations, identical training schedules across conditions, native zero-head equivalence, all four attention layers, frozen backbone and finite gradients.
limitations: The three training pairs and all validation sequences were selected after earlier outcomes. These replicates measure sensitivity to specified random choices, not external generalization or patient independence.
